headline.purpose: Screen identity and important vehicle state.

body.purpose: Controls, timeline content, and customer-facing UI copy.

metric.purpose: Speed, distance, peak speed, and route point counts.

shadows.name: map-float
shadows.purpose: Separates floating map controls and status from changing map content.

shadows.name: sheet-ambient
shadows.purpose: Provides subtle separation between the map and draggable sheet.

motion.name: sheet-spring
motion.purpose: Interruptible bottom-sheet settling after direct manipulation.

motion.name: map-focus
motion.purpose: Camera adjustment when a route point is selected.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single prominent action within a task.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { min-height: 48px; padding: 12px 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 10px; color: #FFFDF8; background: #E4512B; font: 600 15px/1.2 Barlow, sans-serif; transition: transform 140ms cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1), background-color 140ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #B73A20; } .ds-button-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #20231F; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Date Field
components.description: A readable native date control for History ranges.
components.css: .ds-date { display: grid; gap: 4px; color: #6B6E68; font: 500 12px/1.3 Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-date input { min-height: 48px; padding: 0 12px; border: 1px solid #DDD8CE; border-radius: 10px; color: #20231F; background: #FFFDF8; font: 500 15px/1.2 Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-date input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(228, 81, 43, 0.28); border-color: #E4512B; }

components.name: Bottom Navigation
components.description: Stable two-destination navigation for Live and History.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 16px; background: #FFFDF8; border-top: 1px solid #DDD8CE; font: 500 13px/1.2 Barlow, sans-serif; } .ds-nav a { display: grid; place-items: center; min-height: 48px; color: #6B6E68; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 10px; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgba(228, 81, 43, 0.28); } .ds-nav .ds-nav-active { color: #E4512B; font-weight: 600; }

components.name: Metric Group
components.description: Grouped route metrics separated by quiet dividers rather than individual cards.
components.css: .ds-metrics { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); padding: 12px 0; color: #20231F; background: #FFFDF8; } .ds-metrics div { display: grid; justify-items: center; gap: 4px; border-left: 1px solid #DDD8CE; } .ds-metrics div:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-metrics strong { font: 650 32px/1 Barlow Semi Condensed, Barlow, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-metrics span { color: #6B6E68; font: 500 12px/1.3 Barlow, sans-serif; }

narrative.overview: Heartbeats combines the interaction clarity of a modern map utility with the warmth and specificity of a rider's roadbook. The map remains the dominant working surface, while warm paper neutrals, route-orange wayfinding, and journey-log structure give the product a recognizable motorcycle identity without retro costume.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, restrained surfaces with one route-orange accent.
Clear location freshness and semantic safety states.
Large readable metrics and compact journey-log details.
Mobile composition preserved on every viewport.

rules.name: The Route Is Orange Rule
rules.body: Orange communicates movement, selection, or an intentional customer action. It is not a decorative fill for large surfaces.

rules.name: The Read It Outdoors Rule
rules.body: No essential customer-facing text renders below 12px. Map overlays and metadata use sufficient weight and contrast for daylight use.

rules.name: The Map Context Rule
rules.body: Any floating surface must preserve enough map context to understand the vehicle or route position.

dos: Do keep the map and selected location visible while details expand.
Do show exact freshness information instead of an unexplained green dot.
Do use complete WIB calendar-day boundaries for History date ranges.
Do preserve readable text, touch targets, and legal map attribution.
Do use warm roadbook details sparingly to make Heartbeats recognizable.
donts: Don't recreate a desktop dashboard inside a narrow viewport.
Don't use fake license plates, distressed paper, or retro ornament as core UI.
Don't load or render all historical GPS points by default.
Don't expose IMEI-based location access without customer authorization.
Don't use gradients, generic glassmorphism, dark-only presentation, or multiple competing accent colors.
